title: Set fast-tier fees
body: Gov.Configure on the fast tier (on-demand 2-of-3 threshold BLS). Price per request = Threshold x Signer-Fee + Protocol-Fee, in whole RNG (1 to 1,000,000 each). A fee change is money: what every request pays. It moves money or code, so it carries Effective-At (filled by dao-propose: the vote's end + 24 h + 1 day of margin); it takes effect only then, when anyone sends Gov.Apply, and until then validators may leave by the exit hatch (Exit-Now) and the DAO may cancel it (Gov.Cancel). A request already made pays out what it was charged; a request with Max-Price below the new price is refused.
